dedupe_keys.name: despliegue de infraestructura de telecomunicaciones en bienes privados en bogota dc

description: Despliegue de infraestructura de telecomunicaciones en bienes privados en Bogotá DC is a dataset listed in City of Bogotá open data portal (Datos Abiertos Bogotá), an open data portal, published or maintained by Secretaría Distrital del Hábitat - SDHT. Localización de la solicitud recibida para la instalación del conjunto de los elementos activos y pasivos que son requeridos por parte de los proveedores de redes e infraestructura de telecomunicaciones, para la prestación de los servicios de telecomunicaciones, en bienes privados en Bogotá D.C. Coverage: Bogotá. The portal files it under the publisher Secretaría Distrital del Hábitat - SDHT. Its tags are Bogotá, SDHT, estaciones, radioelectricas, telecomunicaciones. It offers 8 resource(s) in DXF, ESRI REST, GEOJSON, GPKG, KMZ. The portal shows 2026-07-07 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution Share-Alike 4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-bogota-portal.
